# Mohamed Amgad Khater

> Security R&D Tech Lead at Cyshield. Builds AI-native security products (an application security platform, agentic SOC systems, and the security architecture behind an AI-powered WAF), the model infrastructure they run on, and the evaluation work that measures them. Offensive security background: OSAI, OSWE, eWPTXv2, eCPPTv2, eMAPT, published CVEs, and disclosures through HackerOne and Bugcrowd.

## Profile

- [About](https://amgad.io/about/): current work, how the products connect, evaluation and model infrastructure, earlier career
- [Resume](https://amgad.io/resume/): experience, projects, skills, certifications, CVEs and awards
- [Certifications](https://amgad.io/certificates/): every certification with a verification link

## Vulnerability research

- [CVE-2026-62000](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/wc-multivendor-marketplace/vulnerability/wordpress-wcfm-marketplace-plugin-3-8-2-broken-access-control-vulnerability): broken access control in the WCFM Marketplace WordPress plugin (≤ 3.8.2)
- [CVE-2026-120524](https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/id/7793c171-8aca-461c-9942-9f4d075be5ae): Subscriber+ stored XSS in the News Kit Addons For Elementor WordPress plugin (≤ 1.4.8)
- [CVE-2026-116557](https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/id/b25cc768-3377-41c9-acf5-8f6c993287c9): unauthenticated calendar note deletion in the WP Booking System WordPress plugin (≤ 2.1.0.5)
- [CVE-2026-116752](https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/id/197252d7-3098-43cd-b680-3d857ddb29ba): Subscriber+ stored XSS in the GeoDirectory WordPress plugin (≤ 2.8.197)
- [CVE-2026-27062](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/wpfunnels/vulnerability/wordpress-wpfunnels-plugin-3-13-5-cross-site-request-forgery-csrf-vulnerability): cross-site request forgery in the WPFunnels WordPress plugin (≤ 3.13.5)
- [CVE-2026-61993](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/blockonomics-bitcoin-payments/vulnerability/wordpress-blockonomics-plugin-3-11-0-cross-site-scripting-xss-vulnerability): cross-site scripting in the Blockonomics WordPress plugin (3.11.0)
- [CVE-2026-111413](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/athemeart-theme-helper/vulnerability/wordpress-athemeart-theme-helper-plugin-1-0-8-cross-site-request-forgery-csrf-vulnerability): cross-site request forgery in the aThemeArt Theme Helper WordPress plugin (≤ 1.0.8)
- [CVE-2026-108481](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/patreon-connect/vulnerability/wordpress-patreon-wordpress-plugin-1-10-0-cross-site-request-forgery-csrf-vulnerability): cross-site request forgery in the Patreon WordPress plugin (≤ 1.10.0)
- [CVE-2026-104803](https://www.wordfence.com/threat-intel/vulnerabilities/wordpress-plugins/wpcom-member/wpcom-member-1727-unauthenticated-authentication-bypass-via-uuid-and-code-parameters-on-social-login-callback): unauthenticated authentication bypass in the WPCOM Member WordPress plugin (≤ 1.7.27)
- [CVE-2026-105059](https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/delete-all-comments-of-website/vulnerability/wordpress-delete-all-comments-of-wordpress-plugin-7-1-broken-access-control-vulnerability): broken access control in the Delete All Comments of WordPress plugin (≤ 7.1)
